subject: [PATCH v3 11/14] selftests/nfsd: exercise listener_set request validation

2026-08-28.patch_summary: This patch adds regression tests to the NFSD (Network File System Daemon) code to exercise listener_set request validation. The tests cover various invalid scenarios, such as bad transport names, missing addresses, and malformed entries. The tests use a stub to create a service and run in their own network namespace. The patch also updates the MAINTAINERS file and adds new directories to the NFSD test suite.
